goal.es: Responder preguntas de sí/no con be

setting.en: The school café is full. Leo, a student, comes to your table.
setting.es: La cafetería de la escuela está llena. Leo, un estudiante, llega a tu mesa.

n1.say: Excuse me, is this seat free?

options.text: Yes, it is. Please sit down.

feedback.en: Leo asked about the seat: 'Is this seat free?' → 'Yes, it is.'
feedback.es: Leo preguntó por el asiento: «Is this seat free?» → «Yes, it is.»

n2.say: Thanks! Are you a student here?

options.text: No, I'm not. I'm a [your job].

feedback.en: Short answers don't use contractions: 'Yes, I am.'
feedback.es: Las respuestas cortas no llevan contracción: «Yes, I am.»

n3.say: I'm a student, too. I'm Leo. Are you from here?
n3.es: Yo también soy estudiante. Soy Leo. ¿Eres de aquí?

options.text: No, I'm not. I'm from [your country].

feedback.en: Leo asked where you are from, not your age.
feedback.es: Leo preguntó de dónde eres, no tu edad.

n3r.say: Ha, OK! But are you from this city?

options.text: No, I'm not. I'm from [your country].

n4.say: Cool. Are you tired? Long day?

options.text: Yes, I am. I'm very tired!

end.say: Me too! Nice to meet you.
